decision.observation: Jump-grab up-left returned me to the lower rail grip again (hand visible, chevron on the mid rail); the eave did not hold. The white tiled wall with blue stripe is close at left.

decision.memory: Up 0.2s + W+Space+J reliably regains the rail-top perch from the grip.
